atten4.ptxt: Arrange the removed parts in order according to their installation positions.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the valve spring retainer locks.
Remove the valve spring retainer, inner compression spring and intake valve.

atten4.ptxt: Arrange the removed parts in order according to their installation positions.

s2.ptxt: Using SST, remove the valve spring retainer locks.
Remove the valve spring retainer, inner compression spring and exhaust valve.

atten4.ptxt: Arrange the removed parts in order according to their installation positions.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Intake Valve Stem Oil Seal

s2.ptxt: Using needle-nose pliers, remove the intake valve stem oil seal.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Exhaust Valve Stem Oil Seal

s2.ptxt: Using needle-nose pliers, remove the exhaust valve stem oil seal.
Using a magnetic finger and an air gun, remove the valve spring seats.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Plug NO.1 (w/ Head Straight Screw)

s2.ptxt: Using socket hexagon wrench 10, remove the 4 straight screw plugs No.1 and 4 water hole gaskets.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Plug NO.2 (w/ Head Straight Screw)

s2.ptxt: Using a 14 straight hexagon wrench, remove the 2 straight screw plugs No.2 and 2 screw plug gaskets.
Remove the ring pins from each cylinder head.
Remove the stud bolts from each cylinder head.
Inspect for Warpage

s3.ptxt: Using a straightedge and feeler gauge, measure the warpage of the cylinder head bottom surface and manifold installation surfaces.

atten4.ptxt: If the warpage is more than the maximum, replace the cylinder head.

s2.ptxt: Inspect for Cracks

s3.ptxt: Using a dye penetrant (red check), check that there are no cracks in the cylinder head.

atten4.ptxt: If there are cracks, replace the cylinder head.

s2.ptxt: Outer Diameter Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a micrometer, measure the diameter of the valve stem.

atten4.ptxt: If the diameter is not as specified, check the oil clearance.

s2.ptxt: Margin Thickness Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the valve head margin thickness.

atten4.ptxt: If it exceeds the limit, replace the intake valve.

s2.ptxt: Overall Length Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the overall length of the intake valve.

atten4.ptxt: If it exceeds the limit, replace the intake valve.

s2.ptxt: Outer Diameter Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a micrometer, measure the diameter of the valve stem.

atten4.ptxt: If the diameter is not as specified, check the oil clearance.

s2.ptxt: Margin Thickness Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the valve head margin thickness.

atten4.ptxt: If it exceeds the limit, replace the exhaust valve.

s2.ptxt: Overall Length Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the overall length of the exhaust valve.

atten4.ptxt: If it exceeds the limit, replace the exhaust valve.

s2.ptxt: Apply a light coat of Prussian blue to the valve face.
Lightly press the valve against the valve seat and, using vernier calipers, check the valve seat contact position and width.

specitem.ptxt: Center of the valve face around the entire circumference (contact width)

item.ptxt: If there is no contact around the entire circumference, replace the valve.
If there is contact around the entire circumference but the contact width is outside the standard, repair the valve seat.

s2.ptxt: Apply a light coat of Prussian blue to the valve face.
Lightly press the valve against the valve seat and, using vernier calipers, check the valve seat contact position and width.

specitem.ptxt: Center of the valve face around the entire circumference (contact width)

item.ptxt: If there is no contact around the entire circumference, replace the valve.
If there is contact around the entire circumference but the contact width is outside the standard, repair the valve seat.
When cutting, always check the valve contact position and width.
Cut so as not to create a step on the cut surface, and gradually reduce force at the end.

s2.ptxt: Using a 45° cutter head, cut the seat so that the contact width is wider than specified.
Using 30° and 60° cutter heads, cut the seat so that the valve contacts at the center of the face around the entire circumference and the contact width is as specified.
Using compound, lap the intake valve and intake valve seat.
After lapping, using Prussian blue, check that the intake valve contact is uniform around the entire circumference.

Cut so as not to create a step on the cut surface, and gradually reduce force at the end.

s2.ptxt: Using a 45° cutter head, cut the seat so that the contact width is wider than specified.
Using 30° and 75° cutter heads, cut the seat so that the valve contacts at the center of the face around the entire circumference and the contact width is as specified.
Using compound, lap the exhaust valve and exhaust valve seat.
After lapping, using Prussian blue, check that the exhaust valve contact is uniform around the entire circumference.
Free Length Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using vernier calipers, measure the free length of the spring.

s2.ptxt: Deviation Inspection

s3.ptxt: Using a square and vernier calipers, measure the squareness (A) of the spring.

atten4.ptxt: If the value is more than the maximum, replace the compression spring.

s-1.ptxt: Inspect Valve Guide Bushing Oil Clearance

s2.ptxt: Using a caliper gauge, measure the inside diameter of the guide bushing.
Calculate the oil clearance from the guide bushing inside diameter and valve stem diameter.

item.ptxt: Oil clearance = Guide bushing inside diameter - Valve stem diameter.
If the clearance is more than the maximum, replace the valve guide bushing.

s2.ptxt: Heat the cylinder head to 80-100°C.
Using SST, tap out the intake valve guide bushing toward the combustion chamber.
Heat the cylinder head to 80-100°C.
Using SST, tap out the exhaust valve guide bushing toward the combustion chamber.
Using a caliper gauge, measure the inside diameter of the guide bushing installation hole in the cylinder head.

s3.ptxt: If the diameter is within specification, install an STD bushing.
If the diameter is not within specification, use a hand reamer and T-type tap holder to ream the bore to 10.335-10.356mm, and install an O/S bushing.

atten3.ptxt: Ream gradually, increasing the hand reamer diameter and applying even force, so that the diameter is within specification.

s2.ptxt: Heat the cylinder head to 80-100°C.
Using SST, tap in a new valve guide bushing to the standard protrusion height (A).
Using a hand reamer and a pin vise, ream the valve guide bushing to obtain the standard oil clearance.

atten3.ptxt: Ream gradually, increasing the hand reamer diameter and applying even force, so that the diameter is within specification.

s2.ptxt: Using a caliper gauge, measure the inside diameter of the guide bushing installation hole in the cylinder head.

s3.ptxt: If the diameter is within specification, install an STD bushing.
If the diameter is not within specification, use a hand reamer and T-type tap holder to ream the bore to 10.335-10.356mm, and install an O/S bushing.

atten3.ptxt: Ream gradually, increasing the hand reamer diameter and applying even force, so that the diameter is within specification.

s2.ptxt: Heat the cylinder head to 80-100°C.
Using SST, tap in a new valve guide bushing to the standard protrusion height (A).
Using a hand reamer and a pin vise, ream the valve guide bushing to obtain the standard oil clearance.

atten3.ptxt: Ream gradually, increasing the hand reamer diameter and applying even force, so that the diameter is within specification.

s2.ptxt: Install the camshaft, camshaft No.2 and cam housing to the cylinder head. (see )
Using a dial indicator, measure the thrust clearance of the camshaft and camshaft No.2.

atten4.ptxt: If the clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the camshaft housing. If the thrust surface of the camshaft is damaged, also replace the camshaft.

s2.ptxt: Install camshaft No.3, camshaft No.4 and the cam housing to the cylinder head. (see )
Using a dial indicator, measure the thrust clearance of camshaft No.3 and camshaft No.4.

atten4.ptxt: If the clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the camshaft housing. If the thrust surface of the camshaft is damaged, also replace the camshaft.

s2.ptxt: Clean the camshaft journals, camshaft housing and bearing caps.
Place the camshaft, camshaft No.2 and camshaft housing on the cylinder head.
Lay a strip of Plastigage across each camshaft journal.
Install the camshaft bearing caps and camshaft housing to the cylinder head. (see )

atten3.ptxt: Do not turn the camshaft and camshaft No.2 while measuring.

s2.ptxt: Remove the camshaft bearing caps.
Measure the Plastigage at its widest point.

atten3.ptxt: Completely remove the Plastigage after measuring.

atten4.ptxt: If the clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the camshaft housing.

s2.ptxt: Clean the camshaft journals, camshaft housing and bearing caps.
Place camshaft No.3, camshaft No.4 and the camshaft housing on the cylinder head.
Lay a strip of Plastigage across each camshaft journal.
Install the camshaft bearing caps and camshaft housing to the cylinder head. (see )

atten3.ptxt: Do not turn camshaft No.3 and camshaft No.4 while measuring.

s2.ptxt: Remove the camshaft bearing caps.
Measure the Plastigage at its widest point.

atten3.ptxt: Completely remove the Plastigage after measuring.

atten4.ptxt: If the clearance is greater than the maximum, replace the camshaft housing.
